detailed_description: A free interactive tool designed for fans attending the FIFA World Cup 2026, helping navigate the complex visa and border control regulations of the US, Canada, and Mexico. Simply select your nationality, existing visas, and custom itinerary across the 16 host cities. The tool dynamically calculates requirements for each international leg, offering warnings on multiple crossings, step-by-step guidance on ESTA/eTA eligibility, visa exemptions, and a personalized checklist of documents to carry.
usage_steps: Select your passport issuing country (nationality) and check any valid visas you currently hold (e.g., US B1/B2, Canada Visa, Schengen, etc.).
In the 'Itinerary Route' section, add host cities in the order you plan to visit them. You can adjust the order using the up/down buttons.
Instantly review the dynamic 'Transit Leg Reports' below to see specific visa requirements and exemptions for each border crossing.
Follow the dynamically generated 'Customs Checklist' to prepare all required digital and physical documents before departure.
usage_examples: Chinese passport holder with no visas traveling from Seattle to Vancouver: System alerts that both US B1/B2 visa and Canada Visitor Visa (TRV) are required.
Chinese passport holder with a valid US B1/B2 visa visiting Mexico City: System confirms visa exemption for Mexico and adds the US visa to the document checklist.
UK passport holder visiting matches in New York and Toronto: System reminds them to apply for both US ESTA and Canada eTA before departure.

faqs.question: Does Mexico's visa exemption using a US visa apply to all nationalities?
faqs.answer: Yes. According to Mexican immigration regulations, travelers of any nationality holding a valid, active multiple-entry visa from the USA, Canada, UK, Japan, or the Schengen Area can enter Mexico visa-free for tourism or match attendance.

faqs.question: What are the risks of entering the same country multiple times on my route?
faqs.answer: If you cross borders multiple times (e.g., US -> Canada -> US), you must hold a multiple-entry visa. A single-entry visa becomes invalid once you exit the country, and you will be denied re-entry. The tool flags multiple crossings to remind you to verify your visa's entry allowance.

faqs.question: What are ESTA and eTA, and when should I apply?
faqs.answer: ESTA (US) and eTA (Canada) are electronic travel authorizations for visa-exempt passport holders (such as GBR, JPN, FRA, etc.). While usually approved within minutes or hours, it is officially recommended to apply at least 72 hours before boarding your flight to account for any processing delays.

faqs.question: Is the information provided by this assistant up to date?
faqs.answer: Yes, this tool is updated with the latest consulate rules for the 2026 World Cup, including Canada's simplified eTA program for certain nationalities holding US visas. However, border rules can change, so we recommend double-checking official immigration websites before you travel.

desc.us_citizen: US passport holders can enter the United States freely without visa documents.
desc.us_green_card: Permanent residents of the US can enter freely. Ensure you carry your physical Green Card.
desc.esta_req: Eligible for Visa Waiver Program (ESTA). You must apply for an online ESTA authorization at least 72 hours before departure.
desc.us_visa_held: Carry your physical passport containing the valid US B1/B2 visa sticker. Ensure EVUS registration is active for Chinese passport holders.
desc.us_visa_req: You must apply for a regular US B1/B2 Visitor Visa at a US Embassy or Consulate prior to your trip.
desc.ca_citizen: Canadian passport holders can enter Canada freely without additional border authorizations.
desc.ca_pr: Canadian Permanent Residents can enter freely. Ensure you carry your physical PR Card.
desc.us_gc_ca: US Citizens and Green Card holders do not require a visa or eTA to enter Canada. Carry proof of US status.
desc.ca_eta_req: You require a Canadian eTA (Electronic Travel Authorization) if arriving by air. Apply online before your flight.
desc.ca_eta_us_visa: Eligible to apply for a Canadian eTA instead of a visitor visa because you hold an active US B1/B2 visa. Applicable for air travel.
desc.ca_visa_held: Carry your passport with the valid Canadian tourist visa sticker.
desc.ca_visa_req: You must apply for a regular Canadian Temporary Resident Visa (TRV) before traveling to Canada.
desc.mx_citizen: Mexican passport holders can enter Mexico freely.
desc.mx_visafree: Your passport qualifies for visa-free tourist entry into Mexico. Fill out the FMM form if required by your airline.
desc.mx_exempt: Mexico exempts visa requirements for travelers holding valid, active visas or permanent residencies of the USA, Canada, Schengen Area, UK, or Japan. Carry the supporting document/visa sticker.
desc.mx_visa_req: You must apply for a Mexican Tourist Visa at a Mexican Consulate prior to travel.

warning.physical_visa: Your route requires one or more standard physical tourist visas. Embassy interviews and physical document submissions will be necessary. Book appointments early!
warning.esta_eta: You require electronic travel authorizations (ESTA or eTA). Make sure to submit online applications at least 3-7 days before boarding flights.
warning.multiple_borders: Your itinerary involves multiple international border crossings. Ensure you have MULTIPLE-ENTRY permits to avoid being denied entry upon return.

checklist.passport: Valid Passport (must have at least 6 months validity left)
checklist.multiple_entry: Proof of Multiple-Entry rights for visas
checklist.tickets: World Cup Match Tickets / FIFA Booking Confirmation
checklist.flights: Confirmed Return or Onward Flight Tickets
